miss.note: The recommender picked minor defect as the middle of a three-way split. A minor defect needs something still wrong after the promise is kept, and nothing was: the test still checks what its name promises, and the change moved its example without checking less. The owner asked for one side on the merits; the second look found the suggestion answer right.

lesson.says: Recommend one outcome on the merits. When the first answers split, do not pick the outcome between them because it lies between them; test each against the rule and commit to the one that holds.
